title: Suno official remote MCP
summary: Suno documents https://api.suno.com/mcp and a sign-in/authorization procedure for compatible assistants. This does not prove an Omega has connected.

build.target: Prove an existing Omega can discover and perform read-only operations through Suno's official remote MCP.
requires: OAuth-capable remote HTTP MCP client in an existing Omega runtime
Separate Suno user authorization; provider feature entitlements
inputs: Omega version, transport details, redacted sign-in evidence
outputs: Documented observed tool list and grant/usage response
Sanitized integration test receipt or precise blocker
execute: Inspect the Omega runtime's actual supported MCP transports and auth method.
Configure the official remote MCP endpoint with no committed secrets.
Authorize through the supported user sign-in flow.
Discover operations and retrieve a read-only account/usage or library resource.
Record response, client version, allowed models, missing grants and any errors without assuming ChatGPT credentials transfer.

applies_when: Milestone M0 must establish Omega-originated operation.
The existing Omega runtime can connect to an official external MCP.
avoid_when: An Omega lacks required OAuth or remote MCP transport; document blocker.
An account connection would require unsafe or copied credentials.

operator: No account writes, credit spends or generation during read-only proof.
Do not store authorization tokens or session secrets.

stop_when: An Omega-authenticated read-only operation is evidenced or a specific blocker is recorded.
Do not claim M0 completed without a real Omega call.

checks: Capture redacted actual Omega operation with tool discovery and server reply.
The separate paid creation criterion remains open until operator approval.
